title: Same-Day Sales Settlement on the Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
Settlement bulletin of the Pocketwire Business Profile. Which of the sales dated on the handling date are still settling depends on the tier of the profile and its age:

- for a profile on Pocketwire Business Premier or Pocketwire Business Enterprise, no sale of the handling date is still settling;
- for a profile on another tier that is at least 12 whole months old, the sales dated on the handling date are still settling except in-person QR-code and tap-to-pay sales, which clear at once;
- for any other profile, every sale dated on the handling date is still settling.

A profile's age in whole months counts a month once the same day of the month as its opening date is reached. The opening date and the tier are those recorded on the profile, and the channel is the one recorded on each sale.

| Tier | Age in whole months | Sales of the handling date still settling |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Business Premier or Enterprise | any | none |
| Starter, Essentials, Growth or Pro | 12 or more | all except QR-code and tap-to-pay sales |
| Starter, Essentials, Growth or Pro | fewer than 12 | all |

## Cases (hypothetical sales of the handling date: USD 300.00 online checkout, USD 120.00 QR code, USD 80.00 tap to pay)

| Profile | Still settling |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Business Growth, 20 whole months old | USD 300.00 |
| Pocketwire Business Growth, 5 whole months old | USD 500.00 |
| Pocketwire Business Premier, 5 whole months old | none |
